decision_reason: Exact-protocol idle-card reruns with no KFD process present at admission raise production natural25 true AR from the published 21.679 to 35.287 tok/s and native B3 from 60.925 to 62.440 tok/s. A matched idle pre-fusion control measures 34.007 AR and 62.167 B3, so the retained fusion improves true AR 3.764% and B3 0.439%, with every category non-regressive. The previous 2.8104x MTP ratio is invalid because its AR denominator was contaminated; the corrected same-run ratio is 1.7695x.

hardware.admission_observation: Both GPUs were 0% busy with no KFD PIDs before the production and matched-control runs.
hardware.mid_run_observation: Only the benchmark child appeared as a KFD process on GPU 1 during each run.
hardware.teardown_observation: Both GPUs returned to 0% busy with no KFD PIDs after the matched control.

superseded_publication_correction.interpretation: The exact published queue environment reproduces the fast idle-card result, ruling out queue policy and confirming contamination of the prior AR denominator. Correctness, acceptance, topology, memory, and the direct matched A/B remain valid; only the old natural25 timing claims are superseded.

limitations: Natural25 has one complete suite run per route, as required by the current dense-suite protocol; the routes ran production then control rather than counterbalanced.
The direct fixed-shape row is a production confirmation, not a fresh matched A/B. The retained matched direct A/B remains 33.534 -> 34.000 tok/s (+1.389%) with unchanged memory.
